Outage summary - checkout platform

Ticket: TCK-88213
Incident: INC-2026-0042
Severity: high

Reported by Mr Hallberg after the nightly deployment.

Impact: card payments failed for eighteen minutes.

Affected host: payments-edge-07.corp.example.com
Internal address 10.42.7.19 forwarded traffic to 203.0.113.44.

The failing call was
https://api.corp.example.com/v1/checkout?order=9912&token=ab12cd34ef56gh78ij90
and every retry returned HTTP 502.

Root cause: a rotated credential was still cached by the worker pool.
The old access key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE had been revoked that morning.
The cached bearer credential was
eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiI0MjAiLCJyb2xlIjoid29ya2VyIn0.7d3JpZ2h0c2lnbmF0dXJlX3Rlc3RfdmFsdWU

Mitigation: the worker pool was restarted and the cache was flushed.
Follow-up owner: Mr Hallberg.
